statusDefinitions.retained-source supported: An explicitly matched retained source passage supports this effect/value; not a new live-game observation.

statusDefinitions.conditional/not valued: Presence/effect is recorded, but its activation, applicability, uptime or magnitude is not a permanent scored contribution.
statusDefinitions.model-only: Selected catalog/solver claim with no sufficiently matched independent retained evidence established by this inventory.

interactionClaims.claim: At most one Minor Artifact may be equipped, regardless of slot
interactionClaims.status: Official historical primary source checked live
interactionClaims.model: includeArtifact adds exactly-one only if a candidate can be selected and not more than one artifact is pinned. There are documented fallback exceptions.
interactionClaims.test: Assert the actual final artifact count is exactly one, independent of includeArtifact and run status.

interactionClaims.claim: Artifact filigrees count toward sets shared with the sentient weapon; capacity differs by artifact
interactionClaims.status: Official historical primary source checked live; selected capacity still needs item-page corroboration
interactionClaims.model: Capacity is carried as Max Filigree Slots, but actual filigree effects and sentient-weapon system are deliberately not modeled.
interactionClaims.caution: Five available slots does not prove five unlocked/filled slots or assign any unmodeled DPS gain. The 2019 statement on identical cross-item filigrees conflicts with later player reports; do not certify that interaction from this note alone.

interactionClaims.claim: Set augments require three copies on three different equipped hosts and suppress each host's native set membership
interactionClaims.status: Retained wiki evidence, not freshly fetched
interactionClaims.model: Host-aware placement and suppression are modeled. Three copies grant one set bonus, not three stacking copies of the stat.
interactionClaims.test: Independently reserve named host/color sockets, reject reused hosts, recount active native sets after suppression.

interactionClaims.claim: Baphomet's Reign has Legendary Deadly +3 and Quality Sheltering +11
interactionClaims.status: Independently retained own-item wiki shard corroborates catalog
interactionClaims.model: Legendary Deadly is a separate typed bucket. Sheltering expands to both PRR and MRR with the same Quality type; only the highest Quality value applies.

interactionClaims.claim: Baphomet's Legendary Conditioning 15 means +15% Legendary maximum HP, not +15 flat HP
interactionClaims.status: Retained wiki template evidence plus independent current indexed item text; direct current item page inaccessible to this agent
interactionClaims.model: Stored as Conditioning | Legendary | 15, separate from flat False Life. Not ranked in the initial revised runs.
interactionClaims.stacking: Solar Enduring 10 uses the same Conditioning/Legendary bucket. Legendary Bulwark's 10% has a different dataset stat label but must not be added to the same Legendary HP bonus. Do not claim 25% from 15%+10%.
interactionClaims.caution: Do not convert this to a precise character HP gain without the character's HP bases and other percentage bonuses.

interactionClaims.claim: Baphomet's Mind Drain reduces maximum spell points by 5%; its stagger needs a melee-weapon vorpal
interactionClaims.status: Independent current indexed item text; needs primary item-page or game-tooltip confirmation for full certification
interactionClaims.model: Mind Drain is represented as Maximum Spell Points (%) | Penalty | -5. Stagger is Boolean and must contribute no bow DPS or ranged crowd-control claim.

interactionClaims.claim: Greater Marksmanship contributes separately from generic Deadly/Accuracy, but multiple copies do not add
interactionClaims.status: Guide's retained explicit stacking evidence; official U66 notes corroborate a ranged attack/damage effect but do not supply its magnitude
interactionClaims.model: Boolean only; a Deadly gain can conceal losing this effect unless its presence is held or explicitly compared.

interactionClaims.claim: Seeker affects critical confirmation and critical damage, not critical threat range
interactionClaims.model: Seeker is numerically scored; critical range/multiplier and weapon base profile are not. Increasing Seeker is not evidence of increased crit range.

interactionClaims.claim: Insightful Deadly does not add to Know the Angles' Insight damage
interactionClaims.status: Published guide's retained build-specific stacking evidence
interactionClaims.model: Insight Deadly is explicitly excluded from optimization credit for this build. Raw gear contributions and objective-comparable contributions must be kept distinct.

interactionClaims.claim: Relentless Fury, Bloodrage, Improved Deception, Salt and elemental attunements are not proven permanent damage bonuses
interactionClaims.status: Retained conditional tooltips and guide evidence
interactionClaims.model: Presence flags generally receive no proc damage/uptime valuation. Improved Deception's numeric value is its Bluff bonus, not guaranteed sneak-attack uptime. Preserve or explicitly describe these flags rather than inventing constant DPS.

interactionClaims.claim: No exact percent DPS improvement is established by a higher lexicographic tuple
interactionClaims.status: Model-boundary finding verified in original engine and project non-goals
